approvalRef: Organization supplement development procedure — supplement number/date blank; basis statement wording
description: Approval-basis cell wording must follow the SOP statement template for the submission type, and Supplement No./Date must be left blank.
findingText: One or more Approval Basis cells do not use the SOP-851-12 prescribed wording (for an STC: 'STC No:' / 'DWG No:' / 'Rev:' / 'Date: ... or later FAA approved revisions.').
resolutionHint: Apply the SOP-851-12 statement template for the submission type (TC, STC, or Drawing). SOP-851-12 directs: do not use wording different from the FAA Orders and sample supplement.
clauseRefs: Organization supplement development procedure — approval-basis statement wording
limitations: Compares the cell against the SOP template shape; it does not validate the underlying approval data.
citationNote: Cites the form/procedure by role; the tenant profile supplies its own controlled document number and revision when the finding is rendered.
